structure.note: One class outstanding. CrowdStrike's charter still provides for Class B common stock, but none has been outstanding since all Class B shares converted into Class A on December 11, 2024; the 2026 proxy states 254,580,533 Class A shares and no Class B shares outstanding at April 3, 2026. A four-for-one stock split (stock dividend) took effect after the close of business on July 1, 2026, after the proxy date.

notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 (CrowdStrike's fiscal 2026). Financial figures are from the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001535527-26-000010, filed March 5, 2026); ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A filed May 5, 2026, accession 0001104659-26-055599), as of April 3, 2026. LEADER: George Kurtz, President and CEO, beneficially owned 2,384,082 shares, marked * (less than 1%) against 254,580,533 Class A shares, so pctEconomic is null. The figure includes 1,804,119 shares held of record, 111,099 shares held by trusts with an independent trustee, 16,875 PSU shares vesting within 60 days, 351,989 options exercisable within 60 days and 100,000 shares held by the Kurtz Family Dynasty Trust. In the 2025 proxy he was listed with 6,321,555 shares (2.53%), most of the difference being shares held by trusts with an independent trustee (4,245,383 then, 111,099 now). SPLIT: all proxy share counts are before the four-for-one stock split effected July 1, 2026 (Q3 FY2027 10-Q); percentages are unaffected. HOLDERS: Vanguard's figure is from a Schedule 13G filed by Vanguard Capital Management as of March 31, 2026; BlackRock's still rests on a 13G as of December 31, 2023 (stale). BUYBACKS: the board authorized a $1.0 billion repurchase program in June 2025, but the fiscal 2026 cash-flow statement shows no repurchases; the 10-K's subsequent-events note reports $50.6 million repurchased between February 1 and March 4, 2026 (fiscal 2027). STOCK COMP: the note total ($1,097.668 million) differs slightly from the cash-flow add-back ($1,096.679 million); the 10-K also corrected an immaterial prior-period error in the timing of stock-based compensation (Note 16).

pay.notes: Employees: full-time head count at January 31, 2026, from the FY2026 10-K; temporary employees and consultants are not included. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2026 is used (same year as the head count); the median employee was identified from about 10,586 individuals employed at December 31, 2025, using total cash compensation plus grant-date equity value.
